svg.title: The colon takes the whole direction
svg.desc: Two panels, each showing the same four by six rainfall grid. On the left, column zero is tinted pink and an arrow carries its four values down into a strip of four numbers. On the right, row one is tinted pink and an arrow carries its six values down into a strip of six numbers. Both results print as a row.
svg.text: The colon takes the whole direction
One number picks one. A colon takes every one in that direction.
Either way the answer prints as a row - being a column is not something it keeps.
